cases.name: rembrandt@0

cases.en: Lighting: Strong deep orange key light from the left side, high above (about 35 degrees); faint soft diffused cold blue fill light from the front, slightly above. Dark surroundings, deep shadows and high contrast (chiaroscuro).

cases.zh: 光线：主光为品红色光，从正前方低处（约 60°，由下往上）照来。中等反差，阴影清晰。
cases.en: Lighting: Magenta key light from the front, from below (about 60 degrees). Moderate contrast with defined shadows.
